name: role-menus
description: Self-service role menus with buttons, selects, reaction menus, and temporary roles

configFields.label: Default Mode
configFields.description: Selection mode used when a new role menu does not specify one

configFields.label: Require One
configFields.description: New menus require members to keep at least one role

configFields.label: Auto Toggle
configFields.description: New menus remove a role when a member selects it again

configFields.label: Default Max Selections
configFields.description: Maximum roles per member for new menus; 0 means unlimited

configFields.label: Default Temporary Duration (seconds)
configFields.description: Default temporary role duration for new menus; 0 means permanent

configFields.label: Maximum Options per Group
configFields.description: Upper bound for roles in one menu
